body:
Boards: columns are as long as their cards and the page scrolls; every list keeps its name in a narrow window, where the hidden heading had made an opened "Anulowane" impossible to close; the workspace Board uses the same board as Projects.

Calendar: compact items (three per month cell instead of one), all-day rows no longer crowd the hours, week and day open at 08:00, the grid ends with the window.

Settings: sections with a rail, saving from the header, no footer; profile list with a switch action, agent and appearance cards, switches for plugins, a timezone map.

Kept, for the owner to decide: a band the height of the floating add button remains below a page's content (reduced from one and a half times that), because nothing may lie under that button. The calendar layout control is still a select.

Verified locally in Chromium on a release daemon; WebKit and a physical phone were not used. Commit 9c50590, rolled out to the manual instance. Evidence: progress/2026-10-07-boards-calendar-settings.md

metadata.summary: Boards as long as their cards, a denser calendar and rebuilt Settings
